verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents its own Experiment management API for creating and controlling flags and experiments from CI, scripts, or your own tools, including holdout and mutex group APIs, and a probe found a published OpenAPI spec. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API matches everything the UI can do, and several UI workflows have no documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity claim, API coverage for visual editor edits, audience definition, duration estimation, cross-project copy and prerequisites, and independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Manage flags, experiments, and deployments from CI, scripts, or your own tools with the Experiment APIs.
Use the Experiment management API to programmatically create and control flags and experiments.
Holdout APIs to create, edit, and display holdout groups and their properties.
Mutex APIs to create, edit, and display mutex groups and their properties.
